evidence: Carries the Validation label, alters `src/validation.cpp` and `src/validation.h`, and addresses assumeutxo snapshot activation and chainstate initialization.
rationale: Fixes an assertion failure that crashes the node and forces a full `-reindex` when any transaction arrives during snapshot validation. Because `PopulateAndValidateSnapshot` releases `cs_main` for several minutes, receiving any transaction over P2P hits `Assertion failed: (!prev_chainstate.m_mempool || prev_chainstate.m_mempool->size() == 0)` in `AddChainstate`, breaking assumeutxo under normal network conditions.
